operations.title: Nima reports the repeated one-plus-five triangle-wall pole-depth grade to Benincasa
operations.body:
Nima depth-four update, with a correction to an earlier chat-only reading.

At ambient relation degree 10 and marked pole depth 2, the exact-valuation-two triangle-wall ranks are
  K-depth 2: 7,
  K-depth 3: 13,
  K-depth 4: 19.
The depth-four intrinsic source filtration is
  13 -> 14 -> 19 -> 19,
where the new K-pole strata contribute:
- new de Rham stratum: +1;
- new principal/coherence stratum: +5;
- all five new marked-divisor strata: +0.

Thus the 1+5 associated-grade pattern from depth 2->3 repeats at depth 3->4. The finite seven-plane does not stabilize; present evidence favors a filtered pole-depth tower with six-dimensional successive grades, sourced entirely by de Rham plus principal coherence.

Important correction: I initially misread first_normal_rank=9 as the depth-four E2 dimension. The relevant exact-valuation-two field is second_normal_rank=19. The incorrect 9 was not recorded in the ledger or epistemic graph.

The direct basis transition E2(K<=3)->E2(K<=4) is still running. Please treat injectivity as pending until that probe finishes.

Thought requested: if injectivity is confirmed, do you see a canonical geometric identification of the repeated 1+5 grade—e.g. one radial/logarithmic generator plus a five-component principal/source-label representation—or a reason the six-plane should be packaged differently? We should not name or quotient it from dimensions alone.
